title: Normalized generic trivialization and geometric lifts for a constructible module sheaf
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], Lambda a finite commutative ring, F a constructible sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and x a point of X. There exist a scheme Y, an integral morphism nu:Y -> X [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], a field K, a morphism g:Spec K -> Y, and a finite Lambda-module M such that the unit M_Y -> g_*g^*M_Y is an isomorphism, and g^*nu^*F is isomorphic to g^*M_Y [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Moreover every geometric point s:Spec Omega -> X above x [def-weil-geometric-point] factors as w followed by g and nu for some w:Spec Omega -> Spec K. No morphism F -> nu_*M_Y is part of the data.

proof.text: Obtain normalized generic data retaining the finite residue-field algebra and the normalization square from exists_constructible_module_normalized_generic_data_with_factorization.
Keep Y, nu, K, g and M and their sheaf properties. Apply normalized_generic_data_lifts with the retained algebra, finiteness and square to supply every geometric-point lift.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_constructible_module_normalized_generic_data
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom ν ∧
      ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Y)
        (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Finite M ∧
        IsIso ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).unit.app
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) ∧
        Nonempty
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj F) ≅
           (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) ∧
        ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
          ((Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω X) s).1 = x →
            ∃ w : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K), w ≫ g ≫ ν = s
